name: @veilio-inc/mcp

tools.name: anonymize_file
tools.description: Read a file from disk and return it with every proprietary identifier replaced by a placeholder (__CLS__1, __FN__2, …) and every credential irreversibly redacted. PREFER THIS over anonymize_text: Veilio reads the file itself, so the real identifiers never enter your context — you only ever see the masked form. Use it before reasoning about, quoting, or forwarding proprietary source. The symbol map is stored locally so the developer can restore an answer later. Files on the raw-only list (.env, private keys, credential stores, .veilio/) are refused, never read.

path.description: File path, relative to the project root.

language.description: Source language. "auto" (default) detects it. Supported: TypeScript / JavaScript, Python, Go, Java / Kotlin, C#, Rust, Ruby, PHP, C / C++, SQL.

preamble.description: Prepend a note explaining the placeholders, for forwarding to another model.

tools.name: anonymize_text
tools.description: Mask identifiers and redact credentials in text passed as an argument. Only use this for text you ALREADY hold — something the user pasted into the conversation. If the content is in a file, use anonymize_file instead: passing file contents through this tool means the real identifiers are already in your context, which defeats the purpose.

language.description: Source language. "auto" (default) detects it. Supported: TypeScript / JavaScript, Python, Go, Java / Kotlin, C#, Rust, Ruby, PHP, C / C++, SQL.

tools.name: scan_secrets
tools.description: Detect credentials — API keys, tokens, private keys, connection-string passwords, emails, private IPs — without modifying anything and WITHOUT putting the values in your context (a finding shows only a value's last four characters and its length). Run this on a file before reading it, or on a diff before committing. Files on the raw-only list (.env, private keys, credential stores, .veilio/) are refused, never read.

path.description: File to scan, relative to the project root.

text.description: Text to scan, if not reading a file.

tools.name: symbol_map_summary
tools.description: Report how many placeholders exist and which kinds. Deliberately returns placeholder KEYS only, never the real names — so you can reason about coverage without de-anonymizing anything.

instructions: Use anonymize_file before reasoning about proprietary source: it reads the file itself and returns only masked code. It does not stop the agent reading files with its own tools, and what those read reaches you as written: with a coding agent, use the guard (veilio-guard, Claude Code), or turn off the agent's own file and shell tools so this server is the only way to the code. Use scan_secrets to check a file or diff for credentials without seeing their values.  this agent has no Veilio guard yet.
